## Product 1: Nourilicious Protein Chapathi Mix

- [Product Page](https://nourilicious.in/products/protein-chapathi-mix): Official detail page and pack selector.
- [Wholesale Order Registration](https://nourilicious.in/contact?type=retail): Register for retail & wholesale launches.
- Category: Everyday Staple Food / Whole Wheat Flour Mix
- Serving Size: 50g (produces approx. 2 medium chapathis) | Servings per 1kg pack: 20
- Protein Content: 15g protein per 2 chapathis (30% protein concentration by dry weight)
- Dietary Fibre: 6.5g per 2 chapathis (13g per 100g)
- Ingredients: Premium Sharbati Whole Wheat Flour (Gehun), Isolated Plant Protein Blend (Pea Protein, Soy Protein Isolate), Whole Grain Dietary Fibre.
- Allergens: Contains Wheat (Gluten), Soy. Produced in a certified clean facility adhering to strict allergen control protocols.
- Pack Options: 1 kg pouch (~20 rotis), 2 kg pouch (~40 rotis), 5 kg pantry saver pack (~100 rotis).
- Culinary Method: Knead with lukewarm water (2 cups flour mix to 1 cup water), rest covered for 10–15 minutes, roll with gentle strokes, cook on hot tawa until puffed. Chapathis remain soft for hours in tiffins.

## Product 2: Nourilicious Protein Cookies

- [Product Page](https://nourilicious.in/products/protein-cookies): Official detail page and cookie pack options.
- [Retail Placement Enquiry](https://nourilicious.in/contact?type=retail): Inquire for modern grocery and supermarket shelf display.
- Category: Mindful High-Protein Baked Snack
- Serving Size: 30g (1 cookie) | Servings per 12-pack: 12
- Protein Content: 10g protein per cookie (33.3g protein per 100g)
- Texture: Authentic oven-baked crispness with golden-brown crumb; no clinical or chalky supplement aftertaste.
- Ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat Flour, Rolled Oats, Plant & Dairy Protein Blend (Pea Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Isolate), Cold-Pressed Vegetable Oil, Unrefined Cane Sugar, Cocoa / Natural Botanical Flavours, Baking Powder, Sea Salt.
- Allergens: Contains Milk, Wheat (Gluten), Oats. May contain traces of tree nuts and soy.
- Pack Options: Pack of 6 (trial pouch), Pack of 12 (standard pantry box), Pantry Box of 24 (family & office bundle).

## Product 3: Nourilicious Isolated Soya Protein Powder

- [Product Page](https://nourilicious.in/products/isolated-soya-protein-powder): Official detail page with pack selector.
- [Bulk & Institutional Enquiry](https://nourilicious.in/contact?type=bulk): Bulk sourcing for commercial kitchens, gyms, and health bars.
- Category: Pure Plant Protein Isolate / Unflavoured Kitchen Booster
- Serving Size: 30g (1 level scoop) | Servings per 1kg pack: ~33
- Protein Content: 27g protein per 30g scoop (90% pure isolate dry basis)
- Macronutrients: <1g net carbohydrates, 0g added sugar, 0.5g fat, 0mg cholesterol, 0g lactose (100% vegan).
- Amino Acid Profile: Complete protein with all 9 Essential Amino Acids (EAAs), rich in BCAAs (Leucine, Isoleucine, Valine) and Glutamine. PDCAAS = 1.0 (highest possible bio-availability rating).
- Ingredients: 100% Non-GMO Soy Protein Isolate (90% Protein Dry Basis), Non-GMO Sunflower Lecithin (<1% for instant lump-free mixability). Zero thickeners, zero artificial flavors, zero chemical preservatives.
- Allergens: Contains Soy. Formulated without gluten, dairy, lactose, or eggs.
- Pack Options: 500 g pouch (~17 scoops), 1 kg pouch (~33 scoops), 2 kg value pantry pouch (~66 scoops).
- 4 Culinary Applications:
  1. Chapathi & Paratha Dough: Add 1 scoop per 2 cups wheat flour before kneading.
  2. Dals, Soups & Curries: Whisk 1 scoop with 3 tbsp warm water to form an emulsion slurry; stir into simmering dal tadka, rasam, or vegetable gravy 2 minutes before serving.
  3. Smoothies & Oats: Blend with almond milk, fruit, and oats for a 27g vegan protein breakfast shake.
  4. Batters & Baking: Stir into idli/dosa batter, besan chilla, or substitute 15-20% flour in pancakes, muffins, and breads.
